name: gen-image-mcp
description: Local MCP for OpenAI-compatible and Gemini image generation, editing, and automatic model fallback.
long_description: Generate and edit images from Claude Code, Cursor, VS Code, Claude Desktop and other MCP clients through any OpenAI-compatible gateway. Supports OpenAI Images API models (e.g. gpt-image-2) and Gemini image models (e.g. gemini-3.1-flash-image / Nano Banana), saves results straight into your project, and can automatically fall back to the next model when one fails.

tools.name: list_models
tools.description: List configured model groups and the tools that use them. Returns configuration only; no network calls.

tools.name: generate_image
tools.description: Generate images with the OpenAI Images API (POST /v1/images/generations), e.g. gpt-image-2, and save them to a local path.

output_path.description: File or directory to write. Relative paths resolve against process.cwd().

filename.description: Optional AI-chosen basename (Unicode allowed, up to 200 UTF-8 bytes, optional extension). Requires output_path to be a directory. Existing names get numbered suffixes instead of being overwritten. Unsafe names are rejected before generation, not rewritten.

model.description: Configured model to start with. Defaults to the first model configured for this tool.

auto_fallback.description: Try the next configured model after an upstream failure. Overrides GEN_IMAGE_AUTO_FALLBACK.

size.description: Output size, e.g. auto or 1024x1024. Defaults to auto.

output_format.description: Output encoding. Omit to let the upstream service decide the format.

tools.name: edit_image
tools.description: Edit or combine local images with the OpenAI Images API (POST /v1/images/edits).

output_path.description: File or directory to write. Relative paths resolve against process.cwd().

filename.description: Optional AI-chosen basename (Unicode allowed, up to 200 UTF-8 bytes, optional extension). Requires output_path to be a directory. Existing names get numbered suffixes instead of being overwritten. Unsafe names are rejected before generation, not rewritten.

images.description: Local image file paths to send as repeated multipart field `image` (max 16).

model.description: Configured model to start with. Defaults to the first model configured for this tool.

auto_fallback.description: Try the next configured model after an upstream failure. Overrides GEN_IMAGE_AUTO_FALLBACK.

size.description: Output size, e.g. auto or 1024x1024. Defaults to auto.

tools.name: generate_gemini_image
tools.description: Generate or edit images with a Gemini image model via POST /v1/chat/completions (e.g. gemini-3.1-flash-image / Nano Banana).

output_path.description: File or directory to write. Relative paths resolve against process.cwd().

filename.description: Optional AI-chosen basename (Unicode allowed, up to 200 UTF-8 bytes, optional extension). Requires output_path to be a directory. Existing names get numbered suffixes instead of being overwritten. Unsafe names are rejected before generation, not rewritten.

images.description: Optional local image paths sent as user content image_url data URLs (max 16).

model.description: Configured model to start with. Defaults to the first model configured for this tool.

auto_fallback.description: Try the next configured model after an upstream failure. Overrides GEN_IMAGE_AUTO_FALLBACK.

baseUrl.title: API base URL
baseUrl.description: Root URL of your OpenAI-compatible gateway, e.g. https://your-gateway.example.com (a trailing /v1 is accepted).

model.title: OpenAI Images models
model.description: Comma-separated OpenAI Images API models in fallback order, e.g. gpt-image-2. Set this and/or the Gemini models.

geminiModel.title: Gemini image models
geminiModel.description: Comma-separated Gemini image models in fallback order, e.g. gemini-3.1-flash-image. Set this and/or the OpenAI models.

autoFallback.title: Automatic model fallback
autoFallback.description: Try the next model in the list when one fails.
